name: New Jersey Statutes
label: New Jersey statutes
record_note: The official STATUTES-TEXT.zip as archived by the Internet Archive on 10 days from 2021-09-22 to 2026-10-25; commits are dated by capture, not by effective date.
author: the chapter law the section's source note gained (Law trailer), when exactly one
granularity: capture date of the official file; one commit per chapter law per capture

scope.when_absent: the file records no case-by-case scope; a law's effective date and application are in the chapter law

default_reach.rule: presumption against retroactivity: statutes apply prospectively unless the Legislature clearly says otherwise
